name: Spectral Wayfarer
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
description: Emerging from the swirling mists and shadowed hollows of the Blightfen Wilds, Spectral Wayfarers drift silently like mournful echoes of lost travelers. Their forms are slender and vaguely humanoid, composed of diaphanous, pale blue-and-gray wisps that flicker and ripple as if caught in an unseen breeze. Hollow eye sockets glow faintly with cold, phosphorescent light, reflecting the ghostly mushroom rings of the Withered Heart Glade and the faint shimmer of corrupted druidic magic. Tattered remnants of traveler's cloaks and weathered boots cling to their ethereal shapes, trailing faintly behind them like frayed banners. The air around them chills and thickens, carrying a faint scent of damp earth and decayed wood, and their movements leave behind a subtle trail of frosted mist that lingers long after they pass. Spectral Wayfarers do not speak but communicate through haunting, wordless gestures, beckoning or warning those who dare to traverse the Blightfen's cursed paths. Their presence is both sorrowful and unsettling--a reminder of the countless souls ensnared by the marsh's dark curse. At twilight, when the fog deepens and shadows lengthen, these phantasms glide through the Gloamreach Lowlands, their luminous forms flickering like flickering lanterns lost to time, guiding or misleading those who wander too close to the ancient, corrupted wilds.
